title: Ice Sorceress on Cliff
description: A female sorceress in a flowing blue gown stands on a snowy cliff edge, holding a glowing blue staff in one hand while conjuring a swirling orb of blue energy with the other. Behind her, a massive icy tornado swirls across a dramatic sky as several dark figures are pulled through the air by golden energy trails.
prompt: A powerful sorceress with long flowing black hair stands on a jagged icy cliff, wearing an ornate blue and gold dress with shoulder pauldrons. She holds a tall glowing blue magical staff emitting lightning in her right hand and casts a swirling blue energy orb with her left. A massive swirling ice tornado dominates the stormy sky behind her, pulling several dark cloaked figures through the air connected by golden energy trails. Distant castle and ships visible on the frozen sea, dramatic cinematic lighting, detailed fantasy scene.
